serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Today I will take {f_botName} to a planetarium.
Tickets were kinda expensive for what they are (2000$), but I already promised to take her there so I kinda had no choice. Buying them on the net was probably still a little cheaper.
We should take a break from her date ideas for a while, it would be beneficial for my health…{{wi}} I froze my ass off on that rooftop…
You: I have two tickets for the planetarium, wanna go?
#bot.Expression.happy
Bot: Sure! 
You: It’s a little far away, but it should be worth it.
